refractiveIndex.source: Jacquemoud & Baret 1990, "PROSPECT", Remote Sensing of Environment 34:75-91 (the cuticle's wax, n about 1.4 to 1.5)

roughness.note: A first cuticle roughness; glossy pads are smoother, papillate petals matte.

transmittanceRatio.source: Woolley 1971; a white petal reflects most of the light and passes about half as much
transmittanceRatio.note: A first ratio of what the tissue passes to what it reflects; to be measured.
